name: Meetup API
tagline: Community groups and local events API for discovery, RSVPs, and meetups
description: The Meetup API provides programmatic access to community groups, local events, memberships, and RSVPs on Meetup. Developers can search for events and groups by location or topic, retrieve event details, manage attendance, and integrate Meetup data into apps for discovery and community engagement.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token via Authorization header; app registration required. Legacy API keys deprecated.

use_cases: find upcoming local meetups near a lat/lon
get details for a Meetup event by ID
list groups matching a topic or keyword
check RSVP count and attendance for an event
search communities by city and category
